nl_statement: For any natural numbers a and b, a squared minus b squared equals (a + b) times (a - b), assuming a is at least b.
expected_lean_statement: theorem sq_sub_sq_nat (a b : ℕ) (h : b ≤ a) : a ^ 2 - b ^ 2 = (a + b) * (a - b)

nl_statement: If a natural number n is divisible by 6, then it is divisible by both 2 and 3.
expected_lean_statement: theorem div6_imp_div2_div3 (n : ℕ) (h : 6 ∣ n) : 2 ∣ n ∧ 3 ∣ n

nl_statement: For any natural number n, 2 to the power n is greater than n.
